newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank bans Czech Ekoagrobanka activities.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank bans Czech Ekoagrobanka activities.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Friday it had banned the Slovak branch of the Czech bank Ekoagrobanka a.s. from accepting deposits and from receiving loans.

"The NBS banned the Piestany-based branch of the Czech Ekoagrobanka a.s...from accepting deposits and from receiving loans, effective today," the NBS said in a statement after the meeting of its governing board.
The statement also said the NBS had initiated the process of revoking the branch's licence.

The NBS move was based on the deteriorating situation in the Slovak branch after Ekoagrobanka entered the central bank's forced administration, as well as its failure to adhere to the conditions set out in its banking licence, the statement said.
The NBS put the Slovak branch of the troubled Czech Ekoagrobanka under forced administration in January this year, following a similar move by the Czech National Bank over the Czech parent.
